verdict.rationale: Grok is delivered as an API/CLI product designed for headless automation: REST (OpenAI-compatible) and gRPC endpoints, API-key based auth with runnable curl/Python examples, a Batch API for async bulk processing, rate-limit/tier documentation, and a Grok Build CLI for agentic coding workflows all support running Grok non-interactively in CI/automation pipelines. Missing for 10: explicit CI/CD (e.g., GitHub Actions) integration examples and independent hands-on confirmation of running Grok inside a CI pipeline specifically.
